card.name: The word Posted in bylines
card.fires_on: The word "Posted" that starts a byline or date stamp at the end of a web post, blog entry or comment, usually just before "by" or a colon and a date.

modes.label: Posted by a user
modes.description: "Posted" followed by "by" and a username or author name after a comment or article.

modes.label: Posted with a colon and date
modes.description: "Posted" followed by a colon and a date right after a title or text.

card.plain: It lights up on the word "Posted" in the byline line under a web post, just before the author or date.
